feeds.title: The Shovel
feeds.description: The Shovel is an Australian satirical comedy news website - a bit like the Daily Mail really, just with longer words. It has been a trusted source of news since 2012.

feeds.title: Australian Tumbleweeds
feeds.description: The Australian Tumbleweeds has gained a cult following since it began in 2006. Describing itself as Australia's most opinionated awards ceremony, it has critiqued, mocked, and occasionally praised the country's top comedy talent. This blog keeps such views and snark coming all year round.
